text:
nick: heads-up: saw an unusual pattern tonight — dedicated-usw2-s14 started spilling egress to eu-west1 proxies and p99 climbed. looks like a tenant is both saturating NICs and causing repeated kvcache rebuilds. can someone triage?

yara: can you paste the quick metric snapshot and hottest host?

nick: slice=dedicated-usw2-s14 hosts=rack-9-host1,rack-9-host2 metric-snippet:
```
nic_tx_mbps_tail=1600
kvcache_miss_rate(tenant=research-x)=0.42
allocs_interactive=9 allocs_batch=61
request_latency_p99=238ms
```

dave: ugh. cross-region spillback likely triggered by our backpressure policy when warm-pool capacity hit. short term: (1) toggle tenant prefetch=false, (2) enable proxy-path-b to shift low-priority egress, (3) throttle tenant at dataplane egress.

oncall: applied prefetch=false for tenant research-x at 2024-12-01T22:07Z, applied egress throttle 30% on rack-9-host1, started warmpool-prefill in usw2-adjacent. infra-bot will monitor.

infra-bot: actions logged. p99 fell to ~110ms after 6min. kv_miss down to 0.11. but two concerns: (A) product teams saw cross-region requests get routed through eu-west1 causing marginally higher latencies for those customers, (B) reserved-cost impact if we start fractional carveouts en-masse.

yara: proposal: add a "self-noise-manage" opt-in tag for tenants. if they opt-in we auto-enable prefetch=false and small fractional carve (1-2 GPUs) and they accept a temporary surcharge. benefits: faster automated mitigation, fewer cross-region spillbacks. downsides: needs billing/legal + UI flow.

dave: alternative conservative policy: fingerprint -> simulation -> canary: fingerprint rule: kvcache_miss>0.25 && nic_tx_tail>900 over 10m -> simulate 72h to estimate fractionation cost -> canary 5% allocs regionally. If simulation cost delta < X then enable automated routing.

nick: agree. immediate follow-ups: 1) yara to draft opt-in UX copy & legal/billing checklist, 2) dave to run 72h sim on top-15 noisy tenants and post reserved delta estimate, 3) oncall to keep the applied throttles for 2h and report. tagging @product for SLA wording and @finance for cost delta. :thumbsup:
